EXW.note: Buyer owns goods from factory gate; GIT is buyer's inventory

FCA.note: Risk transfers at named place; GIT is buyer's inventory

FOB.note: Risk transfers at port of loading; GIT is buyer's inventory

CFR.note: Buyer owns goods once on vessel

CIF.note: Buyer owns goods once on vessel; seller arranges insurance

DAP.note: Seller responsible until destination; do not double-count with open PO

DDP.note: Seller responsible until delivery, duty paid; do not double-count with open PO

DPU.note: Seller responsible until unloaded at destination

note: If incoterm unknown, assume FOB and flag for user confirmation
